```{=html}
                        <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
                    </svg>
                    ¡Copiado!
                `;
                button.style.background = '#10b981';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    button.innerHTML = originalHTML;
                    button.style.background = '';
                }, 2000);

            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', err);

                // Fallback message
                button.innerHTML = `
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
                        <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"></line>
                        <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"></line>
                    </svg>
                    Error
                `;
                button.style.background = '#ef4444';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    button.innerHTML = originalHTML;
                    button.style.background = '';
                }, 2000);

                // Show additional info for unsupported browsers
                alert('No se pudo copiar la imagen. Tu navegador puede no soportar esta función.\n\nAlternativa: Usa "Descargar PNG" para guardar la imagen.');
            }
        }

        function exportConfiguration() {
            if (!data || !displayData) {
                alert('Por favor, genera una visualización primero antes de exportar la configuración.');
                return;
            }

            const config = {
                metadata: {
                    exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
                    version: '9.0',
                    description: 'Configuración del Generador de Warming Stripes'
                },
                parameters: {
                    referenceStart: parseInt(document.getElementById('refStart').value),
                    referenceEnd: parseInt(document.getElementById('refEnd').value),
                    dataStart: parseInt(document.getElementById('dataStart').value),
                    dataEnd: parseInt(document.getElementById('dataEnd').value),
                    width: parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value),
                    height: parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value),
                    chartType: document.getElementById('chartType').value,
                    colorPalette: document.getElementById('colorPalette').value,
                    showLabels: document.getElementById('showLabels').checked,
                    labelInterval: parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value)
                },
                statistics: {
                    referenceMean: refMean.toFixed(2),
                    minAnomaly: document.getElementById('minTemp').textContent,
                    maxAnomaly: document.getElementById('maxTemp').textContent,
                    yearCount: displayData.length,
                    dataRange: {
                        min: data[0].year,
                        max: data[data.length - 1].year
                    }
                },
                data: displayData.map(d => ({
                    year: d.year,
                    temperature: d.temp,
                    anomaly: (d.temp - refMean).toFixed(2)
                }))
            };

            const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(config, null, 2);
            const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.download = `warming-stripes-config-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
            link.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        function downloadPNG() {
            if (!displayData || !refMean) {
                alert('Por favor, genera una visualización primero.');
                return;
            }

            const scale = parseInt(document.getElementById('pngResolution').value) || 1;
            const originalCanvas = document.getElementById('canvas');

            if (scale === 1) {
                // Standard resolution - use original canvas
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = originalCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                link.download = 'franjas-climaticas.png';
                link.click();
            } else {
                // High-DPI - create scaled canvas
                const scaledCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                scaledCanvas.width = originalCanvas.width * scale;
                scaledCanvas.height = originalCanvas.height * scale;

                const ctx = scaledCanvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.scale(scale, scale);

                // Redraw everything at higher resolution
                const chartType = document.getElementById('chartType').value;
                const selectedPalette = document.getElementById('colorPalette').value;
                const COLORS = COLOR_PALETTES[selectedPalette];
                const showLabels = document.getElementById('showLabels').checked;
                const labelInterval = parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value);
                const showTrendLine = document.getElementById('showTrendLine').checked;
                const trendWindow = parseInt(document.getElementById('trendWindow').value) || 5;

                const inputWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value);
                const stripesWidth = inputWidth * 0.5;
                const height = parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value);
                const horizontalPadding = 30;
                const titleHeight = 50;
                const labelHeight = showLabels ? 40 : 0;
                const canvasWidth = stripesWidth + (horizontalPadding * 2);

                const startYear = displayData[0].year;
                const endYear = displayData[displayData.length - 1].year;

                const anomalies = displayData.map(d => d.temp - refMean);
                const minAnomaly = Math.min(...anomalies);
                const maxAnomaly = Math.max(...anomalies);
                const limit = Math.max(Math.abs(minAnomaly), Math.abs(maxAnomaly));

                // Draw title
                ctx.fillStyle = '#505050';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, titleHeight);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText(`${uploadedFileName} - Cambio de temperatura (${startYear}-${endYear})`, canvasWidth / 2, titleHeight / 2);

                const totalBarSpace = stripesWidth / displayData.length;

                if (chartType === 'stripes') {
                    // Draw stripes
                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                        const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                        const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                        const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];

                        const xStart = Math.round(index * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                        const xEnd = Math.round((index + 1) * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                        const stripeWidth = xEnd - xStart + 1;

                        ctx.fillStyle = color;
                        ctx.fillRect(xStart, titleHeight, stripeWidth, height);
                    });

                    // Draw trend line if enabled
                    if (showTrendLine) {
                        const movingAverages = calculateMovingAverage(anomalies, trendWindow);
                        const padding = 20;
                        const chartHeight = height - padding * 2;
                        const centerY = titleHeight + height / 2;
                        const maxBarHeight = chartHeight / 2;

                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
                        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        let started = false;
                        movingAverages.forEach((avg, index) => {
                            if (avg !== null) {
                                const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                                const yPos = centerY - (avg / limit) * maxBarHeight + 2;
                                if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(xPos, yPos); started = true; }
                                else { ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos); }
                            }
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();

                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd700';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        started = false;
                        movingAverages.forEach((avg, index) => {
                            if (avg !== null) {
                                const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                                const yPos = centerY - (avg / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                                if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(xPos, yPos); started = true; }
                                else { ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos); }
                            }
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                } else if (chartType === 'bars') {
                    const yAxisWidth = 50;
                    const chartStartX = horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth;
                    const chartWidth = stripesWidth - yAxisWidth;
                    const barSpace = chartWidth / displayData.length;
                    const barWidth = Math.max(1, barSpace * 0.8);
                    const barGap = barSpace - barWidth;
                    const padding = 20;
                    const chartHeight = height - padding * 2;
                    const centerY = titleHeight + height / 2;
                    const maxBarHeight = chartHeight / 2;

                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a5568';
                    ctx.fillRect(horizontalPadding, titleHeight, stripesWidth, height);

                    // Y-axis
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b7280';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.font = '11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                    const numTicks = 6;
                    for (let i = 0; i <= numTicks; i++) {
                        const value = limit - (i * (2 * limit) / numTicks);
                        const y = titleHeight + padding + (i * chartHeight / numTicks);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 5, y);
                        ctx.lineTo(horizontalPadding + stripesWidth, y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.fillText(value.toFixed(1), horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 8, y);
                    }

                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(chartStartX, centerY);
                    ctx.lineTo(horizontalPadding + stripesWidth, centerY);
                    ctx.stroke();

                    // Draw bars
                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                        const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                        const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                        const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];
                        const barHeight = (anomaly / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                        const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barGap / 2;

                        ctx.fillStyle = color;
                        if (barHeight >= 0) {
                            ctx.fillRect(xPos, centerY - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
                        } else {
                            ctx.fillRect(xPos, centerY, barWidth, -barHeight);
                        }
                    });

                    // Draw trend line if enabled
                    if (showTrendLine) {
                        const movingAverages = calculateMovingAverage(anomalies, trendWindow);

                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
                        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        let started = false;
                        movingAverages.forEach((avg, index) => {
                            if (avg !== null) {
                                const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                                const yPos = centerY - (avg / limit) * maxBarHeight + 2;
                                if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(xPos, yPos); started = true; }
                                else { ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos); }
                            }
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();

                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd700';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        started = false;
                        movingAverages.forEach((avg, index) => {
                            if (avg !== null) {
                                const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                                const yPos = centerY - (avg / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                                if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(xPos, yPos); started = true; }
                                else { ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos); }
                            }
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }

                // Draw labels if enabled
                if (showLabels) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#505050';
                    ctx.fillRect(0, titleHeight + height, canvasWidth, labelHeight);

                    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.font = 'bold 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                    if (chartType === 'stripes') {
                        displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                            if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                                const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                                ctx.fillText(d.year.toString(), xPos, titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2);
                            }
                        });
                    } else {
                        const yAxisWidth = 50;
                        const chartStartX = horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth;
                        const chartWidth = stripesWidth - yAxisWidth;
                        const barSpace = chartWidth / displayData.length;
                        displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                            if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                                const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                                ctx.fillText(d.year.toString(), xPos, titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

                // Download scaled image
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = scaledCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                link.download = `franjas-climaticas-${scale}x.png`;
                link.click();
            }
        }

        function downloadSVG() {
            if (!displayData || !refMean) {
                alert('Por favor, genera una visualización primero.');
                return;
            }

            const chartType = document.getElementById('chartType').value;
            const selectedPalette = document.getElementById('colorPalette').value;
            const COLORS = COLOR_PALETTES[selectedPalette];
            const showLabels = document.getElementById('showLabels').checked;
            const labelInterval = parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value);

            const inputWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value);
            const stripesWidth = inputWidth * 0.5;
            const height = parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value);
            const horizontalPadding = 30;
            const titleHeight = 50;
            const labelHeight = showLabels ? 40 : 0;
            const canvasWidth = stripesWidth + (horizontalPadding * 2);
            const canvasHeight = titleHeight + height + labelHeight;

            const startYear = displayData[0].year;
            const endYear = displayData[displayData.length - 1].year;

            const anomalies = displayData.map(d => d.temp - refMean);
            const minAnomaly = Math.min(...anomalies);
            const maxAnomaly = Math.max(...anomalies);
            const limit = Math.max(Math.abs(minAnomaly), Math.abs(maxAnomaly));

            let svg = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${canvasHeight}" viewBox="0 0 ${canvasWidth} ${canvasHeight}">
`;

            svg += `  <rect x="0" y="0" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${titleHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;

            svg += `  <text x="${canvasWidth / 2}" y="${titleHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${uploadedFileName} - Cambio de temperatura (${startYear}-${endYear})</text>
`;

            const totalBarSpace = stripesWidth / displayData.length;

            if (chartType === 'stripes') {
                displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                    const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                    const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                    const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                    const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];

                    const xStart = Math.round(index * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                    const xEnd = Math.round((index + 1) * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                    const stripeWidth = xEnd - xStart + 1;

                    svg += `  <rect x="${xStart}" y="${titleHeight}" width="${stripeWidth}" height="${height}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                });

                if (showLabels) {
                    svg += `  <rect x="0" y="${titleHeight + height}" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${labelHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;

                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                            const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                            svg += `  <text x="${xPos}" y="${titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${d.year}</text>
`;
                        }
                    });
                }
            } else if (chartType === 'bars') {
                const yAxisWidth = 50;
                const chartStartX = horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth;
                const chartWidth = stripesWidth - yAxisWidth;
                const barSpace = chartWidth / displayData.length;
                const barWidth = Math.max(1, barSpace * 0.8);
                const barGap = barSpace - barWidth;

                const padding = 20;
                const chartHeight = height - padding * 2;
                const centerY = titleHeight + height / 2;
                const maxBarHeight = chartHeight / 2;

                svg += `  <rect x="${horizontalPadding}" y="${titleHeight}" width="${stripesWidth}" height="${height}" fill="#4a5568"/>
`;

                const numTicks = 6;
                for (let i = 0; i <= numTicks; i++) {
                    const value = limit - (i * (2 * limit) / numTicks);
                    const y = titleHeight + padding + (i * chartHeight / numTicks);
                    svg += `  <line x1="${horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 5}" y1="${y}" x2="${horizontalPadding + stripesWidth}" y2="${y}" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
`;
                    svg += `  <text x="${horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 8}" y="${y}" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#ffffff">${value.toFixed(1)}</text>
`;
                }

                svg += `  <line x1="${chartStartX}" y1="${centerY}" x2="${horizontalPadding + stripesWidth}" y2="${centerY}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
`;

                displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                    const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                    const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                    const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                    const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];

                    const barHeight = (anomaly / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                    const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barGap / 2;

                    if (barHeight >= 0) {
                        svg += `  <rect x="${xPos}" y="${centerY - barHeight}" width="${barWidth}" height="${barHeight}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                    } else {
                        svg += `  <rect x="${xPos}" y="${centerY}" width="${barWidth}" height="${-barHeight}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                    }
                });

                if (showLabels) {
                    svg += `  <rect x="0" y="${titleHeight + height}" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${labelHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;

                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                            const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                            svg += `  <text x="${xPos}" y="${titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${d.year}</text>
`;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            svg += `</svg>`;

            const blob = new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.download = 'franjas-climaticas.svg';
            link.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        function resetForm() {
            document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('refStart').value = '1991';
            document.getElementById('refEnd').value = '2020';
            document.getElementById('dataStart').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dataEnd').value = '';
            document.getElementById('showLabels').checked = true;
            document.getElementById('labelInterval').value = '10';
            document.getElementById('chartType').value = 'stripes';
            document.getElementById('colorPalette').value = 'default';
            document.getElementById('outputSection').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('fileMessage').className = '';
            document.getElementById('fileMessage').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('dataPreview').style.display = 'none';
            data = null;
            displayData = null;
            refMean = null;
            selectedYearIndex = -1;
            canvasContext = null;
            chartParameters = null;
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>
```

## Sobre las Warming Stripes

Las **franjas climáticas** (warming stripes) fueron creadas por el climatólogo Ed Hawkins como una forma visual simple pero poderosa de comunicar el cambio climático. Cada franja representa un año, y el color indica si la temperatura fue más fría (azul) o más cálida (rojo) que el promedio del período de referencia.

### Características de esta herramienta

- **Carga de datos personalizados**: Sube tus propios datos de temperatura en formato CSV
- **Período de referencia configurable**: Define el período base para calcular anomalías
- **Múltiples paletas de colores**: Elige entre diferentes esquemas de color
- **Dos tipos de visualización**: Franjas tradicionales o gráfico de barras
- **Exportación flexible**: Descarga en PNG, SVG o exporta la configuración en JSON
- **Estadísticas automáticas**: Calcula tasas de calentamiento y anomalías

### Formato de datos requerido

Tu archivo CSV debe tener dos columnas:

```
año,temperatura
1850,14.2
1851,14.3
1852,14.1
...
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Fuentes de datos

Puedes obtener datos de temperatura de fuentes como:

- [Berkeley Earth](http://berkeleyearth.org/data/)
- [NASA GISS](https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/)
- [NOAA](https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cag/)
- Servicios meteorológicos nacionales
:::

- [Show Your Stripes](https://showyourstripes.info/) - Proyecto original de Ed Hawkins
